//: Configuration A: the same suite on two commits. Both sides are install roots of a build of
this repository (`<checkout>/out/latest`, or a copy of one) -- the directory that holds `bin/`
and `stdlib/` and that CAMEL_HOME points at. The plan files and cases always come from the
checkout this tool lives in, so the two sides are two compilers of the same programs.
This is the shape stage 0's acceptance reads: `output_differ=0` and `graph_differ=0` between
the commits before and after a step that was supposed to change nothing.
Two installs are made by building the same worktree at each commit in turn and copying the
first install aside (`cp -a out/latest /tmp/camel-a`) before the second build:
node test/tools/diff-compare.mjs --config <this file, with those two paths>
label: step0-a-example

a.name: before
a.commit: <sha of the second install's build, for the record>

overrides.//: A case that declares a wider bound in its own `desc` names it here, one entry at a time; nothing is widened to make a comparison pass.

graph.//: The pass whose dump is the canonical form: `std::gir` is compact DOT with the graph references the tooling reads. Any terminal scheduling pass of a block is replaced by this one, so the comparison is of the graph the scheduler would have taken.
